unsupported: Cleaveland/Price serves the medium- and high-voltage electrical industry, supplying utilities, switchgear manufacturers, and automation integrators.

Its automation products, including DNP 3.0 certified controllers, target retrofits of padmount and underground switchgear, while its line sensors and RTUs support power quality monitoring and data acquisition for grid operations.
The company attributes its growth to a continuous R&D program and a vertically integrated manufacturing model that allows rapid iteration.
